title: Florence + The Machine · Dog Days Are Over
description: A white studio fills with blue singers, copper costumes, rolling drums and plumes of color.

performance.lyrics: Happiness hit her like a train on a drive Ah Coming towards her, stuck still no turning back Ah She hid in round corners and she hid under beds She killed the kisses, Ah and from it she fled Live every bubble she sang with a drink and washed it away down the kitchen sink the dog days are over the dog days are done the horse is coming so you better run Run past my own mother, run past for your father, for your children, for your sisters, never about. Leave all your love in your lonely behind, you can't carry with you if you want to survive. The dog days are over and the dog days are down. Ah Ah Ah And I never wanted anything from you Except for everything you had and what was left after that you owe Happiness I hit her like a bullet in the mirror Ah Ah I'm a great height, by someone who should've known that I haven't been there. dark days are over. Oh, the strong days of dawn Can you hear our s As we all lay in calm Run fast for your mother Run fast for your father Run for your children Run for your sisters they will rot us leave by your love and your longing behind you can carry it with you if you want to survive the dog days are over the dog days are over Ah can I hear the horses Ah cause we are late We can't go of you oh, oh, Ah oh, oh, oh oh, oh, oh Ah
